label: raw_source_differences
statement:
SELECT _city city,count(*) listings,
count_if(price IS NULL OR trim(price) IN ('','None','N/A','null')) missing_raw_price,
count_if(substring(trim(price),1,1)='$') dollar_formatted_price,
count_if(host_verifications IS NULL OR trim(host_verifications) IN ('','None','N/A','null')) missing_host_verifications,
count_if(bathrooms IS NULL OR trim(bathrooms) IN ('','None','N/A','null')) missing_numeric_bathrooms
FROM workspace.airbnb_bronze.listings WHERE (_city IN ('milan','florence') AND _snapshot_date=DATE '2026-09-19') OR (_city='venice' AND _snapshot_date=DATE '2026-09-16') GROUP BY _city

label: typed_quality_summary
statement:
SELECT city,count(*) listings,count(DISTINCT listing_id) unique_keys,
count_if(eligible_for_training) valid_target_rows,count_if(eligible_for_analysis) analytical_rows,
percentile_approx(price_eur,0.5) median_price_eur,percentile_approx(price_eur,0.99) p99_price_eur,max(price_eur) max_price_eur,
count_if(raw_price IS NOT NULL AND trim(raw_price) NOT IN ('','None','N/A','null') AND price_eur IS NULL) raw_nonnull_price_unparsed,
count_if(long_stay) long_stay_listings,count_if(has_reviews) reviewed_listings,
max(dist_center_km) max_distance_km,percentile_approx(dist_center_km,0.5) median_distance_km,
count_if(availability_365=0) fully_blocked_listings,count(DISTINCT neighbourhood_cleansed) neighbourhoods,
count_if(days_since_last_review<0) reviews_after_snapshot
FROM workspace.airbnb_silver.listings WHERE ((city IN ('milan','florence') AND snapshot_date=DATE '2026-09-19') OR (city='venice' AND snapshot_date=DATE '2026-09-16')) GROUP BY city

label: new_categories_vs_ab
statement:
WITH v AS (SELECT room_type,property_type FROM workspace.airbnb_silver.listings WHERE city='venice' AND snapshot_date=DATE '2026-09-16'),
rt AS (SELECT DISTINCT room_type rt_value FROM workspace.airbnb_silver.listings WHERE city IN ('milan','florence') AND room_type IS NOT NULL),
pt AS (SELECT DISTINCT property_type pt_value FROM workspace.airbnb_silver.listings WHERE city IN ('milan','florence') AND property_type IS NOT NULL)
SELECT count(*) venice_listings,count_if(v.room_type IS NOT NULL AND rt.rt_value IS NULL) unseen_room_type_rows,count_if(v.property_type IS NOT NULL AND pt.pt_value IS NULL) unseen_property_type_rows
FROM v LEFT JOIN rt ON v.room_type=rt.rt_value LEFT JOIN pt ON v.property_type=pt.pt_value
